$comment: Game portals allowed to embed borderfall.gg. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH.
Three things must agree or a portal's players silently lose their session:
1. nginx `frame-ancestors` (who may frame the HTML)   -> docker/nginx.prod.conf
2. EMBED_ORIGINS on the backend (who gets the cross-site refresh cookie)
3. the client's per-portal policy (e.g. hide our own login UI)  -> frontend/src/utils/portals.generated.ts
Edit THIS file, then run:  pnpm -C backend exec tsx scripts/syncPortals.ts
It rewrites (1) and (3) and prints the value to set for (2). A test fails if any drift.
origins: absolute origins, no path. A leading `*.` matches subdomains only —
never the bare domain (list it too) and never a TLD (`https://*.com` is refused).
Both CSP and EMBED_ORIGINS read this same syntax. Country-code domains are separate
registrations and must each be listed: no TLD wildcard exists anywhere.
BEFORE adding a portal, read its terms — ask a human to paste them. Check the
AI-disclosure policy especially: Newgrounds unpublished us on 2026-09-19 for
not declaring generative-AI use. See docs/PORTALS.md step 1.
ownAuthUi: false when the portal forbids a game showing its own login/registration.
CrazyGames lists 'No external login options' under BASIC requirements.

portals.name: itch.io
portals.notes: Project page is <user>.itch.io (top-level); the sandboxed player is *.itch.zone (immediate parent). Both are ancestors, so both are needed. No rule against our own login.

portals.name: CrazyGames
portals.notes: Basic Launch submitted 2026-09-19. capacitor:// is their iOS app and must be listed with its scheme — a bare host inherits https and the app then white-screens. Regional sites are separate domains, enumerated from their sitelock docs; their docs write `crazygames.*`, which no allowlist syntax can express.

portals.name: Newgrounds
portals.notes: Submitted 2026-09-19 as an HTML5 Archive (scripts/newgrounds-launcher). BOTH origins are ancestors and both are required: the page the visitor sees is www.newgrounds.com, and the uploaded archive is served from uploads.ungrounded.net, which is the immediate parent of our iframe. Read off the live preview's console, not guessed. The bare apex newgrounds.com is NOT listed because it was not observed; add it if the fallback ever shows on a non-www URL. No rule against our own login, unlike CrazyGames.
